violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CDI got food thermometer from car

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried beef and goat meat chunks on counter at 108f-150f waiting to be placed in tomato sauce.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI reheated to 165f within the sauce on the stove. Keep food 135f minimum while prepping other dishes. EHS recommends placing in warmer or keeping hot on the stove top.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed eggs on counter at 70f for 2 hours while waiting to be cooked.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CDI eggs placed in WIC while waiting to be cooked. Do not leave food out of temperature controls until needed for prep.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Wood or wood wicker is used in contact with food. Observed wooden spoons heavily soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. REPLACE WOODEN SPOONS WITH DURABLE UTENSILS THAT WILL NOT CHIP INTO FOOD.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: burnt plastic spoons and spatulas observed melted with food encrusted and not easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. CDI utensils discarded
